title: Asian-Style Veggie Ground Soup with Cabbage, Potato, Carrot & Mushroom

steps.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Medium dice potatoes. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Add to the bowl with the potatoes.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl and set aside.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggie ground and spices; cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
Add vegetables to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly softened, 3-4 minutes more.
Meanwhile, trim off and discard root end of cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into 1-inch wide strips.

When the vegetables are done, add cabbage, broth, soy sauce, and chili-garlic sauce to the pot; stir to combine the soup, then bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender, 12-15 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and enjoy!
